zh: 调货。SuXin Warehouse · 仓库 → 门店
从仓库送去门店：扫要送的货
en: Warehouse to shop: scan what goes

zh: 发货后：仓库马上扣，货在「在途」
en: Dispatched: off the warehouse, now in transit

zh: 门店收到：扫一下到了什么
en: At the shop: scan what arrived

zh: 白米少了 1 包，会记成运输差异
en: One bag short: kept as a transit difference

zh: 哪一次调货少了，一查就知道
en: Find out which transfer came up short
